title: MINVERSE Doolittle-LU landing: 598 of 607 cells, 556 of them fresh
status_plain: The shipping inverse_kernel was Gauss-Jordan on [A|I] - the algorithm W109 had already ruled out - while the catalogue claimed OxFunc already implemented the identified Doolittle LU. Commit d195c17 on 2026-07-13 swapped in Doolittle LU with partial pivot and per-column unit-vector solves, and the source verifies it end-to-end through the compiled surface against cached live-Excel bits at build 20131: 3x3 went from 80 to 150 of 159 cells and 4x4 from 102 to 448 of 448, published as 182 -> 598 of 607, a strict superset with zero regressions. The 607 cells are three corpora, not one: 51 original fitting rows, 108 fresh 3x3 rows that CAUGHT an overfit (a bottom-row reciprocal-multiply back-substitution scored 51/51 on the 51-row set but only 147/159 held out, worse than plain all-division at 150/159), and 448 fresh 4x4 cells harvested separately. So 556 of the 607 cells are held out, and the source uses the words "held-out" and "fresh" for them. The stream is still open with its closure checklist entirely unchecked: nine residual +1/+2-ULP cells on ill-conditioned 3x3 matrices remain, and the residual direction flips, so the source calls it a genuinely different op-graph for those cells.

evidence_locality_note: The three witness corpora (smart-fuzzer/work/w109/G5-01-answers-minverse.json 51 rows, G5-01-answers-minverse-r1.json 108 rows, G5-01-answers-m4b.json 448 rows) are not in version control. The counts are quoted from the committed bug stream and catalogue row.
substrate: crates/oxfunc_core/src/functions/matrix_family.rs::inverse_kernel — Doolittle LU with partial pivoting, forward substitution through the unit lower factor with no division, then division-form back substitution through the upper factor, per column against a permuted unit vector, plain binary64 with no FMA contraction
ruled_out: Adjugate / cofactor adj(A)/det — 51/155 on 3x3 and 85/448 on 4x4.
Gauss-Jordan on [A|I] — 80/159 on 3x3 and 102/448 on 4x4; this was the shipping kernel until d195c17.
A 32-variant solve-ordering sweep (forward/back x stream/sum-then-subtract x ascending/descending x division/reciprocal) — all scored <= 150.
An x87 80-bit extended body with double stores — best 110 of 159, strictly worse; MINVERSE is plain SSE2 double.

Bottom-row reciprocal-multiply back-substitution — 51/51 on the 51-row fitting set but 147/159 on the 108 fresh 3x3 rows, i.e. worse than plain all-division at 150/159. Recorded in the ruled-out ledger as an OVERFIT.

retractions.withdrawn_claim: A Python float64 emulation scoring 448/448 on the held-out 4x4 confirms OxFunc implements the identified algorithm.
retractions.superseded_by: commit d195c17, which found the shipping Rust kernel was still Gauss-Jordan and had to land Doolittle LU
retractions.citation: OxFunc git commit 04f21e9 (2026-07-12) commit message, superseded by commit d195c17 (2026-07-13); docs/OXFUNC_EXCEL_DISCREPANCY_CATALOG.md:147

open_question: Nine residual +1/+2-ULP cells on ill-conditioned 3x3 matrices are unexplained, and the residual direction flips between matrix families, so the source treats them as a distinct op-graph rather than a rounding-count difference.
reader_warning: The 598/607 is a count of result CELLS, not of matrices and not of calls. And the 448/448 that belongs on this page is the one re-scored through the compiled surface at d195c17 - not the identically-numbered Python-emulation figure from the day before, whose accompanying conclusion was false and was retracted.
